meta.title: Kept: a two-minute daily money habit coach
meta.description: Learn one Rich Habits money habit a day, make a small promise, and report back. Kept adapts to you and tracks what you kept.

hero.support: Kept is a two-minute daily coach for the habits that grow your money.
hero.reelLabel: A check-in on Kept, one step at a time

steps.learn: Learn a money skill on your numbers
steps.promise: Promise one small thing for tomorrow
steps.ledger: Watch it add up in your ledger

how.heading: Two minutes a day.
how.barLabel: How a day with Kept is spent

learn.clause: Then learn one money skill, worked out on your own numbers.

spends.heading: Where does your money go?
spends.support: Kept prices every promise from what you tell it. These are Sara’s numbers: she takes home £2,000 a month.

takeaway.sentence: I order takeaway four nights a week.
takeaway.result: Cooking instead saves about £9 a night, about £1,900 a year.

coffee.sentence: I buy coffee out most weekdays.
coffee.result: Making it at home saves about £2.50 a day, about £650 a year.

subscriptions.sentence: I pay for subscriptions I barely use.
subscriptions.result: Cancelling two frees £20 a month for good, £240 a year.

payday.sentence: I get paid once a month.
payday.result: Moving £335 to savings on payday locks in the whole month before you spend it.

spends.total: Switched on, that’s about {amount} a year you keep.
spends.none: Switch on what sounds like you.

about.heading: Kept, like the books.
about.lead: Kept is built on Rich Habits by Tom Corley, an accountant who spent five years studying the daily habits of rich and poor people.
about.second: So your progress is a ledger: promises kept are credits, slips are debits. Every habit is in our own words, and we never promise you’ll get rich.
about.imageAlt: A ledger from the 1830s with a marbled green and gold cover
about.hoursAlt: A handwritten page of accounts from 1846, each job drawn in watercolour beside the hours it took and its price
about.hoursCaption: An account of hours spent, Paris, 1846. Every job entered, every hour counted.

advice.a: No. Kept teaches money ideas using your own numbers. It is education, not advice. Rates like the 4% in a lesson are examples, and the lesson says so.

dayOne.a: About five minutes of setup: your dream, your income, costs and savings, and where your money goes. Kept turns that into a plan and your first promise.

ai.a: Three things: it suggests your plan, marks your answers, and helps you choose a promise when you’re stuck. Code does every sum, so the maths is always right.

missed.q: What if I miss a day?
missed.a: It doesn’t count against you. A promise you don’t report by the end of the next day closes as unreported, and your promises don’t shrink because of it.

install.q: Do I need to install anything?
install.a: No. Kept runs in your browser. One calendar reminder, added once, brings you back each evening and opens today’s screen.

numbers.a: Only you see your plan. Our public results page shows totals across everyone testing Kept, with no names or emails.

cta.note: Next you pick a password. Then about five minutes of setup, and your first promise.

footer.credit: Ledger pictures: The Metropolitan Museum of Art, public domain.
footer.legal: Education, not financial advice. Habits after Tom Corley’s Rich Habits.

questions.text: What do you want to get better at?
questions.weeks: How long will you give yourself?
questions.obstacle: What usually gets in your way?

hints.text: One goal, in your own words. Kept turns it into one small promise a day.
hints.weeks: Long enough to build the habit. You can’t change this once your plan is made.
hints.startingPoint: Be honest: the first promises are sized to where you start.
hints.obstacle: Your plan will work around it.

placeholders.text: I want to run 5k without stopping.
placeholders.startingPoint: I can jog about 1 km, then I have to walk.
placeholders.obstacle: I’m tired after work and skip it.

errors.empty: Write a few words so we can plan around it.
errors.locked: Your plan is already made from these answers, so they can’t change now.
errors.failed: We couldn’t save that. Your answer is still here; try again in a moment.
errors.offline: You’re offline, so nothing was sent. Your answer is still here; try again once you’re connected.

build.title: Ready to make your plan
build.body: Kept turns your answers into milestones, small daily actions and the ideas behind them. It takes about 10 seconds.
build.privacy: Your answers are sent to Google’s Gemini to write the plan. Leave out anything private.
build.failed: We couldn’t make your plan right now. Your answers are saved; try again in a minute.
build.offline: You’re offline, so nothing was sent. Try again once you’re connected.
build.unsafe: Kept can’t plan that goal safely. Here’s a safer version: use it as it is, or change it.

plan.confirmHint: Once confirmed, your plan stays fixed for the test.
plan.confirmFailed: We couldn’t confirm your plan. Check your connection, then tap Confirm again.
